# Copyable

A type whose values `=` may copy: the bound generic code writes before it copies a value of its type parameter.

```rux
pub interface Copyable {}
```

Numbers, `bool`, characters, raw pointers, views, function values, and structures, tuples, variants and fixed
arrays of them are copyable. A type with a destructor, or one holding such a value, owns resources and is
move-only, and so is a type declared `#NoCopy`. A copy is always the value's bytes and never runs user code.
